title: Apple Warns of Limited In-Store iPhone Duo Stock
excerpt: Apple states that in-store availability for the new iPhone Duo will be limited following fast online sellouts ahead of Friday's launch.
body_html:
Apple has announced that physical retail stores will have limited quantities of the iPhone Duo available for purchase. The upcoming device, scheduled to launch on Friday, October 23rd, experienced rapid online preorders that sold out quickly.

According to reports, some online delivery estimates for the device have already stretched into the following year. The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable device, featuring a 5.4-inch outer display alongside a 7.6-inch screen.

Customers hoping to secure a unit during the initial release day are facing constrained supply both online and in brick-and-mortar locations. Apple has not specified exact inventory numbers for individual store locations.
